description: Machine-checkable expected parses for the 76 proposed fixtures in titles.proposed.json (PF-001..PF-076). Converted from the compact expected text; fields the audit leaves open are derived from PC-03 and flagged in note/review_basis. Compared as a SUBSET: a key that is absent is not asserted. hardFlags and softFlags are compared as sets; sideA/sideB must have the same length; pending_fields are skipped (see tests/parser/helpers/compare.ts). origin real-from-spec means the title is verbatim from spec Appendix A.5; every other title is synthetic and must never be presented as real.
